$comment: Single source of truth for the picker. Edit this file, then run `npm run build` to regenerate skills/design-style-picker/picker.md (generated section) and docs/picker-data.js. Scenario regressions live in data/scenarios.json.

scales.kind: style = a whole visual direction (the main pick) · layout = an arrangement you can combine with a style · theme = a colour scheme you can combine with a style
scales.freshness: 1 = reads dated today · 5 = reads current today
scales.density: how much content the style handles well: 1 = showcase only · 2 = mixed · 3 = text/data heavy
scales.a11yRisk: 1 = low accessibility risk · 3 = high risk, needs the era file's fixes
scales.mode: light | dark | both: which colour scheme the style is native to
scales.pages: suitability per page type: 0 = poor · 1 = usable · 2 = great
